title: When the Ledger Falls
author: Ada Okafor
blurb: Wren Ashgrove, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
